messages:
simon: Heads up — APAC spot rebill triggered overnight, looks like ~18% of cost that should've been tagged to projects bounced to `unallocated` during the midnight scale window. Proposing manual rebill to ML-Research + Playground. Need approvals and who will submit the JE/IO.

kai (ops-bot): nightly-cost-recalc job finished: https://redwood.internal/s3/apac-rebill-3170001111.csv — export includes GCP invoice lines + label heuristics.

anika: can you paste the dollar breakdown? the CSV has lots of rows, I'm only seeing `unlabeled` for many entries.

simon: quick summary: total impacted = $12,450. Rough split from heuristics -> ML-Research $8,100; Playground $3,900; Infra/experiments (sandbox) $450. I pulled this from the export filters (label: repo/ml-research, workspace: playground).

rachel: @simon OK for ML-Research to take $8.1k. For Playground — can we have eng tag used notebooks to avoid repeat? cc @eng-infra. :thumbsup:

jen (finance): we need product lead signoff for any rebills > $1k to Playground. Also confirm the ledger/cost_center codes you want on the JE.

anika: I can run the rebill script but need (1) explicit approvals in this thread, (2) target ledger codes, and (3) a JIRA ticket for audit. I will create the ticket and run it once confirmed.

simon: Approved for ML-Research from my side. @rachel please confirm Playground product lead approval inline so @anika can proceed.

rachel: pinged @mike-plt, he replied :thumbsup: and said "ok to rebill Playground for overnight spot churn".

anika: created JIRA RED-11234 - "APAC spot rebill (3170001111)". Running rebill now, will attach JE and CSV. ETA ~30m.

billing-bot: Journal entry created JE-2023-APAC-3170001111 referencing invoice GCP-2023-04-APAC. Attached: https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2023-APAC-3170001111.csv

simon: thanks fam. Follow-up: can eng add a guardrail so we don't rebill when the pool share < 1% and fallback to a short-term tag fix? cc @eng-finance-signal

anika: note — rebill script summary (snippet):
```
project,original_cost,rebilled_to,amount
ml-research,8100,ML-RE,8100
playground,3900,PLAY,3900
sandbox,450,SANDBOX,450
```

anika: I'll attach journal entry + CSV to the JIRA when done. Leaving thread open for audit notes.
notes: rebill requested due to tag loss during autoscale; JIRA + JE created; approvals captured in-thread
